idea: Add a "rectangle-of-two-grids" closed form. Split the square vertically at x = p/(p+q)-type rationals. Fill the left part with an a×b grid of equal squares and the right part with a c×d grid, with the sides chosen as the min of the width and height constraints. Enumerate all integer tuples with total count ≥ n, trim the smallest squares, and keep the best exact value.
